sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Badlands, Desert, and Eroded Badlands.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Bone Club, Bone Rush, Bonemerang, Burn Up, Dig, Heat Wave, Hydro Steam, Needle Arm, Pin Missile, Sand Tomb, Sandsear Storm, Scald, Scorching Sands, Searing Sunraze Smash, Shadow Bone, Solar Beam, Solar Blade, Steam Eruption, and Thousand Waves: 1.5× stronger.
Aqua Ring, Life Dew, and Soak: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ground-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's accuracy.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Earth Eater restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Defense +1, Special Defense +1, Speed +1, and is bound by Sand Tomb.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
